clause_by_clause_review.producer_reason_reviewed: Council creation and membership cap operate only while the Council exists; amended section 3(e) ends it January 16, 1993.
Appointment of the Council's Chairman and Vice Chairman depends on the continuing Council, ended January 16, 1993.
Advice to the President and Economic Policy Council is the Council's function, not an independent post-Council mandate.
Continuing reviews are expressly the Council's advisory duties and cease with its amended sunset.
Executive-agency information duty runs to this Council solely to carry out its functions; it does not command an independent rural-development program after sunset.
Uncompensated service and travel entitlement concern work on the Council. No new Council service is authorized after sunset; any already accrued travel claims are residuals.
Farmers Home Administration support and Agriculture funding are expressly for Council operations/functions and have no separate prospective object after the Council ends.
The FACA delegation is limited to functions applicable to this Council and expressly excludes reporting to Congress. It creates no independent annual report command that survives the Council.
EO12783 replaces the original two-year sunset with the express date January 16, 1993. This is the amended sunset of the Council, not an inferred amendment signing-date onset or a reporting deadline.

inventory_review.scope_note: All reconstructed operative scopes compared against the full held original. No omitted independent command located.

limits: This is AI source review, not an eo-lifecycle-review/v1 independent_human record.
Prospective-authority cessation can be supported while the exact submitted complete first-end claim is rejected.
Original page-image confirmation is not asserted; three EO13350 legal-body rendered pages were independently inspected.
rationale: The exact amended termination date is supported: EO12783 substitutes “The Council shall terminate on January 16,1993.” All nine reconstructed scopes were compared with the complete original. Appointments, advice, review, agency information, service/travel, Farmers Home Administration support/Agriculture funding and FACA delegation attach to this Council. The exception for reporting to Congress creates no separate reporting command. No independent program survives its termination. EO12869 sections 4(c) and 6 establish the later September 30, 1993 formal revocation; they are not substituted for the earlier functional end. Accrued travel rights are residuals.
